_readme: Edit this file - it is the only thing you need to maintain.
hub: jita | amarr | dodixie | rens | hek
fees.broker_pct: 3.0 with no skills, 1.5 at Broker Relations V, lower with standings.
fees.sales_tax_pct: 8.0 with no skills, 3.6 at Accounting V.
items[].cost: what ONE unit costs you (build cost or purchase price).
Leave null if you don't know - you still get market data,
but no margin, no profit floor and no HOLD warnings.
items[].qty: how many you have to sell.
items[].min_margin: optional per-item override of defaults.min_margin (percent).
COSTS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS - replace them with your real numbers.
